title: Coefficient field and transcendence degrees in the smooth strict localization
statement: Let $K$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] and let $Y$ be a smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] finite-type $K$-scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] of Krull dimension $d$ [def-kun-dimension]. For a geometric point $\bar y$ [def-weil-geometric-point] with image $y$, put $a=\operatorname{trdeg}_K\kappa(y)$ [def-kun-transcendence-degree], using the residue field [def-weil-residue-field] and $R=\mathcal O^{\mathrm{sh}}_{Y,\bar y}$ [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit]. Assume additionally that R is equipped with local-ring and integral-domain instances. There is a K-field F and a K-algebra embedding j:F -> R such that F is separably closed [def-pc-separably-closed], reduction R -> kappa(R) composed with j is bijective, trdeg_K F=a, and trdeg_F Frac(R)=d-a for the algebra structure induced by j.

proof.text: Apply the coefficient-field construction theorem to obtain a separably closed K-field F, a K-algebra embedding j into the strict henselization, bijectivity after reduction, and transcendence degree a.
Apply the fraction-field transcendence-degree calculation to this F and j, then assemble all four conclusions.

lean.statement:
theorem smooth_strict_local_field_model_coeff
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsIntegral Y]
    (f : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [Smooth f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (d a : ℕ) (hd : topologicalKrullDim Y = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y)
    (y : Y) (hy : s (IsLocalRing.closedPoint Ω) = y)
    [Algebra K (Y.residueField y)]
    (hκ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (Y.residueField y))) =
      Y.fromSpecResidueField y ≫ f)
    [Algebra (Y.residueField y) Ω]
    (hΩ : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Y.residueField y) Ω)) ≫
      Y.fromSpecResidueField y = s)
    (ha : Algebra.trdeg K (Y.residueField y) = (a : Cardinal))
    [Algebra K (strictHenselizationRing s)]
    (hK : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K (strictHenselizationRing s))) =
      strictHenselizationStructuralMap s ≫ f)
    [IsLocalRing (strictHenselizationRing s)]
    [IsDomain (strictHenselizationRing s)] :
    ∃ (F : Type u) (_ : Field F) (_ : Algebra K F),
      ∃ j : F →ₐ[K] strictHenselizationRing s,
        IsSepClosed F ∧
        Function.Bijective ((IsLocalRing.residue (strictHenselizationRing s)).comp
          j.toRingHom) ∧
        Algebra.trdeg K F = (a : Cardinal) ∧
        (letI := ((algebraMap (strictHenselizationRing s)
            (FractionRing (strictHenselizationRing s))).comp j.toRingHom).toAlgebra
         Algebra.trdeg F (FractionRing (strictHenselizationRing s)) =
           ((d - a : ℕ) : Cardinal))
